_comment: Per-NPC voices for live replies. Slot ids come from the NPC system's voice profile (VoiceSlot). Live replies speak in the NPC's DESIGNED Gemini voice from the audio roster (the same voice as its baked lines) whenever it has one; 'gemini' below is the stock Gemini voice used only for an NPC without one. 'voice' is the OpenAI voice of the development-only realtime mode. Keep in step with ArtDirection/Audio/VoiceScript.md.

F1.persona: a young woman in her twenties with a quick, bright voice

F2.persona: a woman in her forties with a firm, slightly husky, practical voice

F3.persona: an older woman in her sixties with a thinner, warm but shaky voice

M1.persona: a young man in his twenties with a quick, tense voice

M2.persona: a man in his forties with a steady, gruff voice

M3.persona: an older man in his sixties with a deep, weathered, slower voice
